Package com.amibar.boggle.data

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.amibar.boggle.data.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class User extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a user of the Boggle app. This is a simple data class (POJO) used for storing user information, especially when interacting with Firebase Realtime Database.
